title: Shree Cement targets 100Mt/yr installed capacity by 2031 financial year
content:
India: Shree Cement plans to raise its cement production capacity to 100Mt/yr ‘over the next three to four years’ up to the middle of the 2031 financial year. Chair Hari Mohan Bangur told Press Trust of India News that Shree Cement’s plans involve composite annual capacity growth of 9 – 10% up to the end of the 2033 financial year, compared with a projected industry-wide forecast of 7 – 8%.
